notes: One object per 2014 source feature. Later construction is absent; a property can have multiple objects.
AI generated wall appearance is generic, not a real facade survey.
Ground is inferred from building bases. Raw 2022 LiDAR sample remains in its own vertical frame.
manifest.featureDefinition: One mesh node per unique source feature ID; multiple features may describe one physical property or complex.

runtime.loadPolicy: Continuous navigation; retain overlapping sections, preload neighbors around camera focus, unload distant sections and restore per-building edits on return.
runtime.destruction: Runtime triangular roof-prism fragments, gravity, approximate ground bounce; no structural solver.
runtime.collision: Per-feature local AABB metadata. Debris-to-ground approximation. No vehicle or character controller.
